question: I'm a CS junior (P-005) with a Mathematical Sciences minor. Can I complete both the CS degree and Math minor by Spring 2027 (2 more semesters) without overloading each semester?

domain_contributions.programs: P-005 CS progress: 15-112 through 15-451 and 15-440 done. Remaining: 15-441, CS electives, and Math minor courses (21-355, possibly 21-484 or 21-441). Math minor gap identified
domain_contributions.schedules: 15-441 ✓ Spring 2026; 21-355 ✓ Spring 2026; 21-484 ✓ Spring 2026. Fall 2026 would offer 15-440 (already done) — key question: are remaining courses available in Spring 2027?
domain_contributions.policies: P-005 in good standing; 2 semesters = Spring 2026 + Fall 2026 (or + Spring 2027). Can take normal load (~45 units). Without overloading, ~3-4 courses per semester

wrong_if_single_domain: Knowing only program requirements counts remaining courses but cannot project semester availability. Knowing only Spring 2026 schedule shows what's available but not what P-005 needs. Policy context defines the capacity per semester without overloading.
common_mistake: Underestimating Math minor requirements and assuming CS electives alone are all that remain; or assuming Math minor courses conflict with CS courses without checking schedules

Step 2 (schedules): Key courses 15-441, 21-355, 21-484 all Spring 2026 ✓ — can take 3 in one semester
